replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics feels like a rigid language, not art. I prefer the fluidity of philosophy and art where ideas breathe. Numbers are cold, structured, and often overwhelming for me. I focus more on visual storytelling through photography than abstract formulas, finding logic in composition rather than equations.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, definitely. The pressure of exams and expectations makes my stomach tense. I worry about failing or not being smart enough. My anxiety spikes when topics get abstract, like calculus. It's easier to lose myself in a movie or a photo shoot than face those stressful math problems.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Not really. I prefer asking friends or searching online forums. AI tools sometimes feel impersonal or too dry for my learning style. I want human connection, not just quick answers. Though I’ve heard they work for others, I still stick to traditional methods for now.
